candidate.title: Candidate Assessment Result
candidate.description: Represents an ENT resident applicant's coping assessment submission and committee evaluation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the candidate submission.

candidateName.description: Full name of the resident candidate.

hospitalOrSchool.description: Current hospital, medical school, or institution of the applicant.

submittedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the assessment was submitted.

answers.description: Map of set IDs to most and least option keys.

optionPointBreakdown.description: Detailed points mapping for each scenario option.

dimensionResults.description: Calculated scores across the 14 coping dimensions.

domainResults.description: Calculated percentages across the 4 coping domains.

redFlagAnalysis.description: Support Needs Index (Red Flag) score and risk tier.

rpgProfile.description: Gamified RPG character sheet including archetype, buffs, and stats.

candidateContextNote.description: Optional context note written by candidate for the interviewers.

institutionalCarePlan.description: Departmental care commitment items selected by the committee.

committeeNotes.description: Evaluation notes from the interview committee.

committeeStatus.description: Review status determined by the committee.

interviewerRating.description: Rating out of 5 stars given by the interviewer.

/candidates/{candidateId}.description: Collection of candidate situational coping profiles and committee reviews.
